title: the Deep Rising Again
author: Casper Ravensworth
blurb: Sebastian Pemberton, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
